info.title: byteplusomnihuman/omnihuman-2.0
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "byteplusomnihuman/omnihuman-2.0", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for byteplusomnihuman/omnihuman-2.0; use POST /v2/models/byteplusomnihuman/omnihuman-2.0/requests.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/byteplusomnihuman/v2/tasks`. The model is fixed by the route. The job is billed per second of the returned video, which is as long as the audio.

example.prompt: The person speaks calmly to the camera.

audio_url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the speech audio. WAV or MP3, under 15 MB, 4 to 300 seconds. The output video is as long as this audio.

enable_watermark.description: Whether BytePlus adds a watermark to the video. BytePlus defaults to true when this is omitted.

image_urls.description: Exactly one public HTTP or HTTPS URL of an image of a person. JPEG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC or HEIF; under 30 MB; aspect ratio (width/height) 0.4 to 2.5; 300 to 6000 px per side.

prompt.description: Optional text that controls the scene, movement and camera. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (Mexican) or Indonesian.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for `byteplusomnihuman/omnihuman-2.0`: the terminal `GET /proxy/byteplusomnihuman/v2/tasks/{task_id}` document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task (`data.status: done`) rather than the handle the submit returns. The generated video is at `data.video_url`, valid for one hour.

resp_data.description: Extra result data from BytePlus as a JSON string. It can be empty; the output length is not reported here.

status.description: The task state. in_queue and generating are in progress; done is finished; not_found, expired, failed and canceled are terminal failures.

video_url.description: URL of the output MP4 when status is done, valid for one hour.

code.description: 10000 on success. Any other value is an error.
